name: Nightly dependency check
description: Once a night, list dependencies with known advisories, prepare one upgrade pull request and ask a person before it merges.

steps.title: Pick the upgrades worth doing
steps.instruction: Read the audit output. Pick only upgrades that close a known advisory and are not major version jumps. Explain each choice in one line.

steps.title: Prepare the upgrade pull request
steps.instruction: Apply the upgrades chosen above on a new branch and open one pull request.
